integrity: The 2025 primary full text was inspected at the defining PDF/CDF, survival and hazard formulas, the advertised hazard-shape claims, and the MSC metadata. The 2026 follow-up was inspected at the same parent distribution and its hazard discussion. The endpoint theorem is derived directly from the defining CDF, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the universal right-endpoint behavior but not a complete phase diagram of interior hazard turning points.
It does not classify lower-endpoint behavior.
A very recent unindexed correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: Right truncation forces a universal TEA hazard blow-up
